# Van Squads

> Van Squads (vansquads.com) is a directory of local mobile service businesses that travel to customers — "Local services. At your door." Customers browse by ZIP, compare packages with upfront prices, and send booking requests. Business owners list free: no listing fees, no commissions.

## Key pages

- Home: https://vansquads.com/
- Browse services by ZIP: https://vansquads.com/#/browse
- How it works: https://vansquads.com/#/how-it-works
- List your business (free): https://vansquads.com/#/join
- About: https://vansquads.com/#/about
- Blog (customer Q&A): https://vansquads.com/blog/

## Service guides

- Mobile car detailing guide: https://vansquads.com/services/mobile-car-detailing/
- Mobile pet grooming guide: https://vansquads.com/services/mobile-pet-grooming/
- Home cleaning guide: https://vansquads.com/services/home-cleaning/
